description: Task templates that fire when a matter enters an attorney-owned stage. Turns each SLA into a concrete to-do (or checklist) in the app's task system. Client-owned stages are handled by the nudge engine, not tasks. Each task carries a soft internal due date (buffer) and the hard SLA deadline.

scope.client_stages: Not tasked — driven by the nudge engine (see nudge_schedule / config/nudge-templates.json).
scope.date_bounded_stages: Discovery/PMPS/Signing are client-scheduled; no attorney work task. Signing prep is folded into the Closeout-adjacent stages where attorney action is real.

due_date_model.description: Two dates per task. The soft date is the internal target that creates urgency before the SLA bites; the hard date is the SLA itself, which drives the dashboard red flag.

fields.hard_due_at: stage_entered_at + sla_days (business days). The SLA; matches stage_sla.
fields.computed_in: business days, America/New_York, excluding firm_holidays (reuse business_days_elapsed inverse).

due_date_model.display_rule: Surface soft_due_at as the task's working due date; show hard_due_at as the SLA badge. Task goes amber at soft_due_at, red at hard_due_at.

granularity_rationale.proposal_ea_out: Single headline task — it's one fast generate-and-send action; a checklist would be overkill.
granularity_rationale.drafting: Checklist — this is the multi-step block (generate, QA, format, PDF, send) and the place sub-steps get dropped.
granularity_rationale.revisions: Short checklist — pull structured changes, edit, cross-check, resend; cross-check is the step that protects against inconsistency.
granularity_rationale.closeout: Checklist — funding package, summary, portal stage update, deliver; several discrete deliverables.

task.title: Send proposal + engagement agreement — {client_name}
task.description: Auto-generate the proposal and EA from PMPS data and route to SignWell. Should go out before the next task begins.
task.on_complete_hint: Completing this typically coincides with the matter advancing to EA Pending Signature.

task.title: Draft documents — {client_name}
task.description: Generate, review, and send the draft package. Batch with other matters at this stage.
checklist: Run document generator from design payload
Review output against design sheet / questionnaire (catch placeholder + field errors)
Cross-check named parties consistent across all documents
Send drafts to client with review summary + revision-intake form link

task.title: Incorporate revisions — {client_name} (round {review_round})
task.description: Process the structured revision request. Handle in the Tue/Thu revision batch.
checklist: Open structured revision request; sort by triage (fast / substantive / question)
Make substantive edits; cross-check ripple across related documents
Resolve or reply to any 'question' items
Re-send revised drafts to client for review

round_cap_check.over_cap: Flag for fee conversation before processing.

task.title: Closeout — {client_name}
task.description: Produce and deliver the post-signing package; close the matter.
checklist: Generate and send estate plan summary
Confirm executed documents stored to OneDrive matter folder
Update matter stage to closed in the app

on_stage_entry: When a matter enters an attorney-owned stage, look up the matching template by stage_key.
Compute soft_due_at = stage_entered_at + soft_lead_days (business days); hard_due_at = stage_entered_at + sla_days.
Create the task (or checklist with sub-items) in the app's task system, assigned to the attorney, with batch_tag for grouping.
Idempotency: one task per (matter_id, stage_key, stage_entered_at) — same pin as the nudge log, so a re-entry into the stage (e.g. revisions round 2) creates a fresh task.
fire_logic.on_stage_exit: Optionally auto-complete or archive the open task for the stage being left, so stale tasks don't linger when the exit trigger fires.
fire_logic.matters_table_assumption: Reuses stage_entered_at, track, current_stage already required by the stage engine. No new matter fields.

task_table_suggestion.description: If tasks are persisted (vs. created directly in the app's native task store), this is the minimal shape.

dashboard_integration.description: These tasks ARE the 'My Queue' from the aged dashboard, now actionable.
rules: My Queue task list = stage_tasks where status='open', ordered by hard_due_at, then soft_due_at.
Amber when now >= soft_due_at; red when now >= hard_due_at (mirrors v_matter_aging health).
batch_tag lets the attorney filter to a work block: all 'drafting_qa' together, all 'revisions' on Tue/Thu.
